transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net, my name is Clive. How can I help you?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hi. My internet has been down for a week now. My daughter has her exams and she can't revise online, and every time I call I get passed around. I'm at breaking point.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Can I take the account PIN, please?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you, Rosalind. Which router do you have?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: The black Hub 4.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And when did the problem start?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Last Tuesday. A week ago.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Are any lights on?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Power is on, and the internet light is red.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Have you tried restarting it?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Many times. Every day.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let me place you on a brief hold while I run a line test.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thanks for holding. The line test shows a fault outside the property.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: So what happens now?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Which router did you say you have?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: The Hub 4. The black one.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And it started when?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Last Tuesday. I've told you all this.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: If you'd listened the first time we wouldn't be going round in circles. I'm just checking the details.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Excuse me?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Anyway. That'll be Openreach's cable, nothing I can do about it. I'll put a request in for an engineer.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: When will they come?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: One moment while I check the schedule.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thanks for waiting. The request is in. They usually come within five working days.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Five more days? She has exams on Monday.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's the earliest. Anything else?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: No. Nothing.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for choosing S-Net.
